title: altingia cunninghamii
intro: Altingia cunninghamii, commonly known as the Kappara or Taiwan cinnamon tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Altingiaceae. Native to Taiwan and other parts of East Asia, this plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Altingia cunninghamii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include immunomodulation, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
